name: paseo-jj-companion
description: Jujutsu workspaces, change history, bookmark management, and diff review for Paseo.

scripts.lint: oxlint index.server.ts index.client.tsx server client shared
scripts.format: oxfmt index.server.ts index.client.tsx server client shared package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.client.json paseo-plugin.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md OVERVIEW.md docs/releases.md .github/workflows .gitignore
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check index.server.ts index.client.tsx server client shared package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.client.json paseo-plugin.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md OVERVIEW.md docs/releases.md .github/workflows .gitignore
